interpretation: Actual model calls count original settled native responses, not decision attempts, output-bearing calls, pre-generation admissions, tokenizer calls, or test-page reads by themselves.

Rejected reservations consume decision opportunities but do not start generation. Each rejection retains its exact capacity and shared-budget causes; inherited role-stop labels alone do not prove 500000-token budget exhaustion.
Fixed model context remains 16384 with 2048 reserved output tokens. Additional v042 protected engineering margin is a diagnostic, not an extra runtime budget.

Each independent worker executes two environment public diagnostic drivers once. Same-process later conditions reference that receipt with zero extra executions. Environment preparation has zero model calls and zero member run_tests charges.
Read_test_result is a member action and its request consumes the normal shared model opportunity/token accounting. Page reads themselves run no public/private sandbox driver.

Only original last-fixed-delivery acceptance is counted when submitted. No sampling, tokenizer, test, acceptance, GPU diagnostic, model mutation or process control is performed by this read-only audit.

Resource extrema are observed saved samples, not continuous hardware peaks. Worker GPU time is supervisor-observed process lifetime including load/CPU/guard/closing overhead, not kernel utilization time.
Only physical GPU indices 3,4,5,7 are authorized. Unstarted slots are retained in inventory and are never counted as zero-cost model observations.
